image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a green, algae-covered rocky surface. The crab's broad oval carapace is purplish-brown with lighter mottled patterns. It has five pairs of walking legs extending laterally, with the first pair modified into robust claws. The claws appear to have dark tips. The crab's eyes are stalked and protrude from the anterior carapace margin. The ventral surface is partially visible and appears cream to white. The exoskeleton has a smooth, glossy texture.
